searches.note: Twenty three searches of twenty eight, five unspent. Most searches blocked the author's own domains so the second source would be independent; two were held to the house's own domain to read its sheets. No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: founding, people and dates, grapes, sites, making, label words, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
Where a search contradicted the record it was set right with its source; where a detail stood in one source or none it was cut or hedged.

Porseleinberg and Goldmine shares, mica schist, concrete tulips, whole bunches, foudres and demi-muids for up to 18 months: Southern Wines, wine-pages, Roberson, Timeless Wines, the house's 2023 sheet read in search (cold room, no acidification, soft délestage, gravity, Austrian oak). Sound.

codexTensions: The library record p-boekenhoutskloof gives its country as Australia, New Zealand, South Africa and South America, a sheet label rather than a country (the author's report, confirmed). Reported, not edited.

The region's producers line for Haute Cabrière says the house made the valley's first Cap Classique in the mid 1980s, but Boschendal at the valley's mouth made its first in 1981 under the same founder; the line holds only if Boschendal's Groot Drakenstein is counted outside the valley. Reported, not edited.
